profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at IQ Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enhancing Automatic Train Supervision software via bugfixes and feature development C/C++.
Developed embedded controller software for an External Heart Pump C++.
Added Bluetooth serial communication to Ventilators at Philips Respironics using C/C++.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Adding Bluetooth serial communication to legacy Ventilators using C/C++.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
C/C++ on QNX platform for serial data communications with ABB AC160 systems.

SQL queries for system data reporting.

C++ maintenance programming for feature add to mature in-house legacy software.

C# internal software to interface with SQL queries and tables.

ABB AC160 PLC programs for nuclear safety platform.

Python data processing scripts for data collection and formatting for database input.

Programming life-cycle documentation.

Requirements traceability.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded Software Engineer, worked on Montreal Metro project.  C++/C code on Windows CE for data logging.  TCP/IP interfacing with Java and Visual Basic.NET applications running on wayside stations.

Also C/C++ on custom Motorola 68332 Processor board (Ansaldo proprietary).

IBM DOORS for requirements traceability.
